concerns.text: The plan describes computing Molar Refractivity and converting it to RI via the Lorentz‑Lorenz relation, but provides no citation to the original Lorentz‑Lorenz source or to the atomic fragment constants (e.g., Meylan et al.). This violates Constitution Principle II, which requires all external citations to be verified.

The plan references processing “graph objects” but never explicitly mentions the `MoleculeGraph` entity defined in `data-model.md`. Aligning terminology would improve consistency between the plan and the data model.
